text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Furioso seemed calm and collected.
On the other hand, I was so nervous—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Review the data once more?
I have already looked over it at least ten times, so I believe it is sufficient."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Remember when we first teamed up in Funabashi?
You were fidgeting the entire time, Trainer.
choice_data_list: If anything, you stayed calm and I could really count on you.
If anything, you remained calm and were very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I didn't notice my surroundings at all.
—Because my heart was burning with passion."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Even now, that very same fighting spirit burns right here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please wait for me.
I will return with victory once again today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Just like when we first started running!
